name: Bailey
description:
100% Brazillian Remy Hair This wig has a soft, dimensional level 9/8 blonde look with a natural shadowed root. The color blends beige and sandy blonde tones with subtle darker lowlights throughout, giving it depth without looking overly contrasted. The face framing pieces are bright and flattering, while the overall finish stays soft, neutral, and luxurious.

The hair is long, sleek, and straight with a smooth blended finish and a natural center part. Overall, it gives a polished, expensive blonde look with plenty of dimension.

Because this is 100% Brazillian Remy human hair, treat and style her just like your natural hair. She arrives professionally colored and styled, but shipping may affect the finished look, so you may want to restyle her to your preference after unboxing.
